newsitem.title: USA: Del Webb Q3 net new orders decline.
newsitem.headline: Del Webb Q3 net new orders decline.

text.p: Del Webb Corp, which builds active adult communities, said on Thursday net new orders for its third quarter ended March 31 declined 8 percent to 1,638 orders versus 1,788 for the comparable period one year ago.
Home closings for the third quarter increased 6 percent to 1,467 units compared to 1,388 during the same period one year ago, the company said.

For the nine month period, net new orders declined 3 percent to 4,079 orders compared to 4,190 for the comparable period one year ago while home closings increased to 4,362 units verus 3,678 a year ago, Del Webb said.
The backlog of homes under contract at March 31 declined 14 percent from the comparable period one year ago to 2,916 units, the company said.
The total contract amount of the backlog at March 31 was $566 million, down 13 percent from a year earlier, it said.
Chairman and Chief Executive Officer Phil Dion said that despite the decrease, third quarter orders on a company-wide basis remain at healthy levels.
The company said it would release full results later this month.
